About¶

The CHAVI client is a Django application that is designed to allow users to manage the data for the CHAVI project. This allows the users to add, edit, and review the clinical data related to the patient before the data is ready for uploading to the CHAVI database. The application allows the users to add, edit, and review the following data:

  • Patient Demographics
    • Diagnosis data
      • Lesion

        • Lesion Response

      • Pathology data

        • Immunohistochemistry

        • Cytogenetics

        • Somatic Genomic Alterations

        • Epigenetic Modifications

        • Gene Expression Data

      • Systemic therapy

        • Systemic Therapy Drug Schedule

      • Radiation therapy

        • Radiation Volume

        • Radiation Dose Volume Data

      • Surgery

      • Concomitant medications

      • Other Treatment

      • Cancer Outcomes

    • Laboratory results

    • Patient Repoted Outcomes

    • Comorbidities

    • Symptoms

    • Patient Assessment

    • Stage Information

    • Patient Outcomes

  • DICOM Studies

As well as typing data in by hand, the application can:

  • Bring in data from spreadsheets — see Importing data

  • Read documents such as reports and pull out the clinical details — see Pulling Data Out of Documents

  • Fetch scans directly from your hospital’s imaging system — see Getting Scans from the Hospital Imaging System

  • Remove identifying details before data is shared — see De-identifying Patient Data
